verdict.rationale: Linear supports natural-language interaction extensively via Linear Agent, Loops ('describe the job in plain language'), Write with Agent, and @mentions that trigger agent actions (e.g., '@Linear can you take a stab at this?'), plus an MCP server for AI assistants. However, the primary UI (issue creation, filtering, project management) remains structured/manual rather than fully natural-language driven, so NL commands supplement rather than replace the core interaction model.
